uncited: **Inputs:** A set of low-resolution input images from a forward-facing capture.
**Input Preparation:** Collect a set of input images from a forward-facing scene.
**MPI Prediction:** Pass each input image through the trained 3D convolutional network.
Identify the nearby input views whose predicted MPIs are relevant to the novel viewpoint.
Warp or project the MPIs from these nearby input views into the coordinate system of the novel viewpoint.
*   **Time Complexity:** LLFF is significantly faster than methods that optimize a separate network per scene.
*   **Memory Complexity:** LLFF produces a large 3D voxel grid for every input image, resulting in enormous storage requirements.
*   **When to use:** When fast processing of well-sampled, forward-facing scenes is required and storage is not a constraint.
*   **When not to use:** For scenes with large baseline disparities, or when storage efficiency and view consistency are critical.
